verdict.rationale: impots.gouv.fr is an online government tax service, and such a service could plausibly offer programmatic or headless access for automation, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only interactive web portal features (login spaces, online payment, simulators, forms, cadastral extracts). It contains no CLI, API, headless mode or CI integration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
